description: owsproxy.lgl-bw.de: inland waterway datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by owsproxy.lgl-bw.de. Coverage: the area served by owsproxy.lgl-bw.de. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about inland waterway; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: LGL-BW SAT Sentinel-2 2020 10 Kanal 20m Bodenauflösung; LGL-BW SAT Sentinel-2 2024 10 Kanal 20m Bodenauflösung; LGL-BW SAT Sentinel-2 2023 10 Kanal 20m Bodenauflösung; LGL-BW SAT Sentinel-2 2021 10 Kanal 20m Bodenauflösung. Formats seen: WCS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.lgl-bw.de/agb/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
